key_insight: Lifting suitable Gaussian Bures–Wasserstein optimization problems into Euclidean affine transport maps enables BW-FISTA to achieve a minimax-optimal O(k⁻²) objective gap.
engineering_relevance: For Gaussian variational inference with log-concave, log-smooth targets, BW-FISTA improves the theoretical convergence rate from O(k⁻¹) to O(k⁻²).
method: Represent Gaussian measures through affine transport maps.
Apply accelerated proximal gradients when the lifted components satisfy convexity, smoothness, and proximability conditions.
Handle the entropy term in Gaussian variational inference with an efficient, exact proximal step.
evidence_signal: Synthetic experiments numerically verify the predicted convergence improvement.
watch_item: The accelerated guarantee requires suitable convex affine lifts and does not automatically extend to arbitrary objectives or non-log-concave inference targets.
paper_title: An Accelerated Proximal Gradient Method for Bures-Wasserstein Space
